ana: Quick GA callout — we9ve launched async-batch-v1 on Hosted API: a first-class async job endpoint for bulk/long-running generation + webhook callbacks. :tada:
ana: Why this exists: customers asked for reliable bulk generation with retries, priority queues, and webhooks instead of polling. This is not streaming; it9s job-style. Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/async-batch-v1
ana: API surface: POST /v1/jobs?model=async-batch-v1 accepts an array of prompts. Returns 202 + job_id. Check status GET /v1/jobs/{id} or configure callbacks via X-Callback-URL and X-Callback-Secret. SDK helper: client.jobs.create(...)
dan: Runtime notes: jobs are sharded into priority queues (standard/priority/express). We enforce per-tenant inflight limits and backlog caps; excess jobs receive 429 with retry-after.
dan: Idempotency: support Idempotency-Key header to dedupe retries. Payloads larger than 64KB will be rejected with 413.
nikhil: Security/ops: webhooks sign with HMAC using X-Callback-Secret header; we had a canary issue where content-type mismatch caused signature validation to fail. Ticket RED-9210 filed.
lucy: Migration: legacy bulk-gen-v0 will be deprecated in 60 days; we9ll provide a migration script to translate existing bulk jobs to async-batch-v1 format.
sre-ops: Monitoring: dashboards and alerts created. Alerts: job_failure_rate > 0.8% or queue_wait_p95 > 5s -> pager. Synthetic tests added to hit callback flow.
devx: I'll add samples for the SDK and quickstart showing webhook verification and Idempotency-Key usage. Also adding a note to the streaming FAQ clarifying this is async, not streaming.
csm-ops: Customer comms: plan is targeted email + in-app banner for tenants using bulk-gen-v0 + proactive outreach to top 50 customers.
deploy-bot: deployment/redwood/runtime/async-batch v1.0.0 succeeded (job 89233) :rocket:
ana: ETA for RED-9210 patch is EOD; fallback plan is to auto-retry failed callbacks and surface failures in the job status. Thanks to eng-runtime, security, devx, and SRE for the push. :clap:
